title: AnimateDiff & SVD Parameter Comparison Tool
purpose: Reusable structured comparison of AnimateDiff (v1-5-3, Lightning 2/4-step, AnimateLCM) and SVD variant (SVD, SVD-XT, SVD 1.1) settings as documented in art_01M6F0HYSTG2XTRQWZ10DDT2A9 r2. Flags documented contradictions (AnimateLCM step range, v1-5-3 scheduler change) and computes step-count ratios vs the full-diffusion baseline. Intended as a starting configuration checklist, not a test of rendered output.
execution: See separate execution receipts; publication alone is not a passed test.
